title: Enterprise Flex Billing: Approval Pipeline & Security Questionnaire Integration Guidelines
creator: Asha Mehta
description: Define a repeatable internal approval pipeline and pricebook update process that supports 'Flex Billing' enterprise proposals (hybrid reserved + usage discounts), and integrates an SQ (security questionnaire) gating mechanism for discounting and contract approvals. Goal: reduce review cycle time for enterprise deals > $50k ARR while preventing unmanaged discount leakage and ensuring security/compliance gating for sensitive customers.
acceptance_criteria: A documented approval pipeline exists describing roles, thresholds, and decision SLAs for Flex Billing proposals
Pricebook update playbook created (steps, owners, rollback plan) and linked to Confluence
SQ gating rule defined and implemented: discounts > 20% require completed SQ and Security approval
Sales can submit Flex Billing requests via SFDC opportunity fields; automated ticket created for PM/Finance review
Price changes publishable to pricing API and reflected in billing system within defined SLA (T+2 business days for minor updates)
Monitoring dashboard shows discount rate by rep, average approval time, and number of deals blocked for SQ incompletion

decisions: Discount thresholds: baseline 10% delegated to Sales Manager, 10-20% requires Finance review, >20% requires Finance + Security + Legal (final signoff by VP Sales for >30%).
SQ gating: deals with discounts >20% or request to store customer data in private deployment must have completed SQ (vendor questionnaire) before Finance or Legal approval can be given.
Pricebook publication SLA: Minor adjustments (formatting/labels) T+1 business day; rate changes require T+2 business days and automated rollback window of 24 hours post-publish for emergency revert.
Automation: SFDC opportunity field will trigger a PR to the pricing review queue; manual override allowed but must create audit log with justification and approver signature.
links: ENG ticket for automation: ENG-20411 (SFDC -> Pricing Review Queue)
rollout_plan: Phase 0 (Pilot) - Select two AE teams and two Finance reviewers. Run pilot for 4 weeks on deals that meet Flex Billing criteria. Measure approval latency and correctness.
Phase 1 - Implement SFDC fields + automation (ENG-20411) and Confluence playbook updates. Train Sales and Finance. Launch to North America teams.
Phase 2 - Add SQ integration; require completed SQ for gated deals. Expand rollout to EMEA, monitor region-specific legal exceptions.
Phase 3 - Full enforcement: enforce gating rules in workflow; deprecate manual shortcuts except with executive exception recorded in audit log.
monitoring_metrics: Average approval time (hours) for Flex Billing requests
% of deals requiring SQ that have completed SQ before approval
Total discount dollars granted by tier (0-10%, 10-20%, >20%)
Number of manual pricebook edits and time-to-rollback
Incidents where discounts caused <5% revenue variance in billing reconciliation
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: Sales friction if workflow is too heavy -> Mitigation: pilot with small AE teams and iterate on field UI; provide deal desk support windows
Risk: SQ review creates bottleneck -> Mitigation: pre-qualify customers and run parallel reviews; add SLA for Security reviews (48 hours)
Risk: Manual pricebook edits introduce errors -> Mitigation: require audit logs and owner signoff; implement automated sanity checks in pricing pipeline
